findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: trustycap_list_capabilities · Private data: trustycap_production_readiness, trustycap_production_standard, trustycap_production_plan, trustycap_list_capabilities, trustycap_list_native_kits, trustycap_get_native_kit · Public sink: trustycap_list_capabilities, trustycap_list_native_kits · Destructive: trustycap_production_readiness, trustycap_production_plan, trustycap_list_capabilities, trustycap_list_launch_kits.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: trustycap_list_capabilities · Private data: trustycap_production_readiness, trustycap_production_standard, trustycap_production_plan, trustycap_list_capabilities, trustycap_list_native_kits, trustycap_get_native_kit · Public sink: trustycap_list_capabilities, trustycap_list_native_kits · Destructive: trustycap_production_readiness, trustycap_production_plan, trustycap_list_capabilities, trustycap_list_launch_kits

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
